pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain homes bees; Grace gives an ally a hit-blocking bee; Bounty creates a temporary attacking hive; Chaos creates a healing/slowing honey storm with explosive bees.
